summary: Worksport Ltd filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a public offering of 208,333 common shares and accompanying common warrants to purchase up to 208,333 shares (or 291,667 on cashless exercise). The combined public offering price is $1.20 per unit, with a warrant exercise price of $1.50. The offering is conducted through placement agent D. Boral Capital on a best-efforts basis. This is an ordinary equity shelf takedown under Form S-3, subject to the I.B.6 one-third public float limit. There are no special-situation elements; it is a routine capital raise.
